Glad you got it working. I saved a note in the project's EngramDB memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. If someone hits this on a new machine or after upgrading wkhtmltopdf, that note should come up.

When this session started, the repo had no uncommitted changes. So if your fix is a code or config change rather than something in your own environment, it may be worth committing so CI and other developers get it too.
